name: safety
description: Can damage hardware or cause unsafe motion, heat or pressure; fixed first

name: security
description: Hardening; vulnerabilities go through a private advisory instead

name: breaking
description: Changes a public API, a config layout or stored data; needs a Breaking changelog entry

name: standard
description: Brings the repository in line with the engineering standard

name: hardware-verified
description: Run on real hardware; the PR says which board

name: needs-hardware
description: Needs a run on real hardware before release

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers would welcome a pull request

name: board-request
description: A new board, library part or circuit block

name: erratum
description: A known anomaly in a released design; listed in the board's errata
